evidence.note: Every route row shows Q3 on-time beside its Q2 prior-period value and a change in points (12 Cross-town 85% -> 70%, -14; 14 Cross-town 85% -> 74%, -11; other six median 87% -> 87%, under 1).
A Network row (86% -> 81%, -5) gives a network-wide baseline to compare the diverted routes against.
Caption gives the range for the other six (within 2 points of Q2, 85-90% in Q3) and flags Route 7 as partial data (9 of 13 weeks).

Insight overlay adds no new bare figures; it interprets the comparison.

rationale: Every key figure on the slide sits beside a prior-period value, a change, a network baseline or a range, and the data caveat on Route 7 supplies uncertainty context. No figure is left bare for the audience to judge unaided. This matches the pass descriptor.
